articles.translatedExcerpt: Salan, the two-man band consisting of Len and Kaito, will release their first full album in about five years, ``CINEMA'', on Wednesday, October 14, 2026. This work is a concept album with the theme of "Is life a movie? Is J-POP crazy?" All 10 songs are named after classic movies. It begins with Mike Nichols' ``The Graduate'' and concludes with Giuseppe Tornatore's ``New Cinema Paradise.'' The attempt to enter the world of movies and sing about one's own life from within has been sublimated into melodious J-POP. This is the second work in the trilogy concept, following the first album "NOVEL" released in 2021 and "LIFE". In addition to the electronic drums and live drums used for each song, the Wako time signal recorded in the hustle and bustle of Ginza, the sound of the movie theater's movie theater, etc.
